summary.en: Sudan’s war has spread to its power grid, with attacks disrupting electricity supply across the country. The UN peacekeeping chief warned that RSF drone strikes launched from Ethiopian territory pose a new threat to civilians, prompting Ethiopia to expel six Sudanese consular staff and close Sudan’s consulate, while Sudan shut the Ethiopian consulate in retaliation. Factories are struggling to restart after wartime damage. The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sudslands krig har spredt seg til strømnettet, med angrep som forstyrrer strømforsyningen i hele landet. FN-s fredsbevarende sjef advarte om at RSF-militsens droner angrep fra etiopisk territorium utgjør en ny trussel mot sivile, noe som førte til at Etiopia utviste seks sudanske konsulære ansatte og stengte Sudans konsulat, mens Sudan stengte den etiopiske konsulatet i gjengjeldelse. Fabrikker sliter med å starte opp igjen etter krigsskade. Konflikten forårsaket 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
